name: probe-p1
refs: THE ART DIRECTOR'S HAND SKETCH of P1, the field scanner (its shape, proportions and parts; a flat sketch: paint it as a real matte object, without the sketch's black outlines):
THE STATION'S SIGNED LOOK (the matte sage field case with sand latches: same maker, same soft painted matte rendering, no ink):
prompt: Output a NEW image, 16:9: a design sheet of the Companion's hand-held field instrument, the PROBE, in its variant P1, the FIELD SCANNER: an UPRIGHT hand-held unit, like a small walkie-talkie. The reference is a flat hand sketch of P1's shape, proportions and parts: paint it in EXACTLY that shape as a real MATTE object (soft painted forms, NOT inked, no black outlines, hairline edges only; the sketch is flat, do not copy its black outlines). Body: OFF-WHITE with a SAGE band across the middle; a DARK RUBBER FOOT (a flat dark base). It carries, as in the sketch: a RUBBER CARRY LOOP on top (a dark rubber loop handle); a ROUND RADAR SCREEN on the upper front, a dark round panel in a rim with a thin sweep line and THREE small dots (green, amber, sky blue) on faint concentric rings: it must clearly read as a radar SCREEN, NOT an eye (a dark disc with rings and a sweep, no pupil, no iris, no highlight, flat matte); a SHORT SENSOR MAST at the top right (a thin short stick with a small round tip); THREE SMALL STATUS LAMPS in a row below the screen (green, amber, sky blue), UNLIT (small round matte bumps, never glowing); the SAGE BAND; a WINDOW into a POD CHAMBER low on the front, a dark window holding TWO EGG-SHAPED PODS side by side (one green, one soft violet); a SMALL INTAKE HATCH on the right side (a small sand hatch flap); WHITE CLIP-ON SHIELD PLATES: matte white clip-on guard plates on the left and right sides of the body, THREE at tier 1 (one on the left upper side, one on the left lower side, one on the right upper side). COMPOSITION: ONE picture on a FLAT neutral mid-grey ground (uniform, no gradient, no horizon, only soft contact shadows), with NO WRITING anywhere: no text, letters, digits, labels, captions, titles or names. From the left: the Probe at TIER 1 (three white plates), LARGE (about 70 percent of the picture's height), seen THREE-QUARTER from the front left; to its right, the SAME Probe at TIER 2, a little smaller (about 55 percent of the height), seen the same way, with a FOURTH white plate (on the right lower side) and a FITTED PART on its side (a small sand module clipped into a round socket on the left side); at the far right, small, the same Probe as a SOLID FILLED flat black silhouette (one colour, completely filled, no detail inside), about one quarter of the tier 1 one's height. NEVER: a face or eyes (the round screen is a screen), a needle or gauge needle, a net, a weapon, any glow, any gloss, chrome, glass shine, blue or cool light on the body, wood.
